card.description: An end-to-end RAG system for retrieving information from telecommunications technical documentation and generating grounded answers with citations.

details.subtitle: Graduation Project · 2026
details.overview: Designed, implemented, and evaluated an end-to-end RAG system for retrieving information from telecommunications technical documentation and generating grounded answers with citations.

sections.title: The Problem
sections.content: Technical telecommunications documentation contains extensive specifications and detailed information spread across multiple PDF documents. Finding the right passages, resolving follow-up questions, and verifying the source of an answer can be time-consuming. General-purpose language models may also produce answers that are not adequately supported by the available documentation.

sections.title: The Solution
sections.content: Designed and implemented a web-based RAG system that retrieves relevant information from technical PDFs and generates answers grounded in the retrieved content. The system combines semantic and lexical search, contextual reranking, and history-aware query rewriting, with a context-verification step and page-level citations. A complete web application supports document management, authenticated access, conversational interactions, and source inspection.

sections.title: Key Features
content: PDF Document Management — Upload technical PDFs and track their indexing status.
Conversational Question Answering — Ask questions and follow up while using conversation history to understand the context.

Intelligent Query Routing & Rewriting — Determine whether a question needs rewriting and, when necessary, use conversation history to reformulate follow-up questions into clearer, context-aware queries before retrieval.
Hybrid Information Retrieval — Combine semantic search with keyword-based retrieval to find relevant passages.
Contextual Reranking — Reorder retrieved passages to prioritize the most relevant information.
Grounded Answers with Citations — Generate answers supported by retrieved content, with source and page references.
Source Inspection — Open a citation to inspect the retrieved passage and corresponding PDF page.
Context Verification — Check whether the retrieved information is sufficient before generating an answer.
User Accounts and Chat History — Authenticate users and manage their conversations.

content.title: Query Routing & Rewriting
content.description: Determine whether a question needs rewriting and, when necessary, use conversation history to clarify its meaning.

content.title: Document Processing & Chunking
content.description: Extract and clean PDF content, then organize it into parent and child chunks to support retrieval and provide broader context.

content.title: Hybrid Retrieval
content.description: Search for relevant passages using semantic embeddings and lexical keyword matching.

content.title: Contextual Reranking
content.description: Reorder retrieved passages to prioritize the most relevant evidence.

content.title: Context Verification
content.description: Assess whether the retrieved information is sufficient to answer the question.

content.title: Grounded Answer Generation
content.description: Generate an answer from the retrieved context, include source and page citations, and avoid answering when the available evidence is insufficient.

card.description: A business intelligence pipeline integrating data warehouse modeling, ETL workflows, dashboards, and predictive analytics.

details.subtitle: Academic Project
details.overview: Designed and implemented a business intelligence pipeline using generated datasets covering books, customers, sales, and stores. The project integrates data warehousing, ETL workflows, dashboard development, and predictive analytics.
details.problem: Book sales data from multiple related datasets needs to be integrated and organized to support effective reporting and analysis.
details.solution: Developed a business intelligence pipeline combining data warehouse modeling, ETL processes, data visualization, and analytical workflows using Talend, MySQL, Power BI, and KNIME.

card.description: A machine learning project applying predictive models to estimate advertisement click-through rates.

details.subtitle: Machine Learning Project
details.overview: Applied machine learning techniques to predict advertisement click-through rates using a real-world dataset.
details.problem: Predicting whether an advertisement will receive a click is a classification task that can be approached using historical data.
details.solution: Applied machine learning models to predict advertisement click-through rates and evaluated their performance using a dataset.

card.description: A Python-based OCR pipeline for extracting information from business card documents using image preprocessing and text recognition.

details.subtitle: Internship Project · Algeria Partners · Jun–Aug 2025
details.overview: Developed a Python-based OCR pipeline to extract information from business card documents. The workflow combined image preprocessing with Tesseract OCR to recognize text and support document information extraction.
details.problem: Business card information stored in document files can be difficult to extract and organize manually, particularly when processing large collections of cards.
details.solution: Developed an OCR pipeline using Python, image preprocessing, and Tesseract OCR to recognize text from business card documents and support information extraction.
